name: Decoupled Toolbox for Color Field
description: Makes Color Field compatible with Decoupled Toolbox.
project_description: Decoupled Toolbox for Color Field is a sub-module of Decoupled Toolbox. Makes Color Field compatible with Decoupled Toolbox. It ships a single decoupled field formatter (plugin `decoupled_color_field`, class `ColorFieldDecoupledFormatter`) so that color_field_type fields can be placed on the Decoupled view mode and serialized to JSON by the parent module's collection endpoint. Requires the contrib Color Field module. Extends `GenericDecoupledFormatter`.
